text:
alex: Quick async OKR handoff — one-liners please: 1) shipped, 2) slipped (why), 3) next step + owner. Cover infra/runtime, dedicated, model rollouts, and any cross-team blockers. Keep one line per area.

maria: Search indexing perf — shipped to prod last night, ~25% median latency drop :tada:. Owner: jin. Next: monitor 2w. No slips.

jin: Confirming — rollout complete on eu/us. Added a short live dashboard: /dash/search-latency. Will watch heatmaps.

samir: Dedicated autoscale policies — slipped. Blocker: infra quota bug causing slow node start (eng-infra ticket #2147). Impact: delays on predictable bursts for some tenants. Next: @katie to patch + smoke test. ETA EOW. Owner: samir (coord).

katie: Patch is merged to staging, smoke tests passing. Rolling to canary now. Will update when canary hits prod.

priya: Model rollout for chat-default v1.3 — partial canary (10%) rolled, we saw prompt drift on a small eval set. Slipped on full rollout. Next: new prompt eval + rollback to 5% until quality fix. Owner: priya.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for chat-default v1.3 -> canary 5% at 1768806820.

maria: Observability workstream (per-route cost dashboards) — shipped initial dashboards for top 10 routes. Next: add token-level breakdown (owner: maria). No slips.

alex: Cross-team dependency note — autoscale patch (katie) is blocker for Dedicated SLA test scheduled Friday. If patch misses ETA, we should reschedule SLA cert. @samir please state fallback plan.

samir: Fallback = temp capacity reservation on us-west pool (manual). Needs approval from infra (katie) + finance for cost delta. If patch delayed >48h we trigger fallback.

priya: Customer communication: I can send a short note to the pilot tenants if rollout stays at 5% past tomorrow. Will defer to eng on timing.

katie: If canary looks green at +1h, I'll promote. If not, I'll open an incident channel and we can activate fallback.

alex: Thanks all. Action items recap (short):
```
- jin: monitor search latency dashboard (2w)
- katie: finish canary -> promote or open incident (ETA EOW)
- samir: prepare fallback capacity plan + cost estimate (48h)
- priya: standby customer comms if rollback persists
- maria: add token-level breakdown to per-route dashboards
```

alex: Please update this thread when you hit the next milestone so I can fold into the OKR doc. Short updates only, plz. :hands_together:
